# aiuis

> File-based mdx cms on solid-start: pages and collections live in
> src/content, custom-developed routes mix in cms documents via <Slot>.

This is the base llms.txt. It's served at /llms.txt and is the fallback for
any cms-backed page without its own pair document — append /llms.txt to a
page url to get its llm-friendly version.

- About: /_/about
- Privacy: /privacy
